title: BanglishDepYT: Depression Detection in Native Bengali Social Media with Emotion-Preserving Preprocessing and Domain-Adaptive Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.01633v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Depression affects millions of Bengali speakers across South Asia, yet automated detection systems have relied almost entirely on datasets translated from English. Such datasets cannot capture the emoticons, romanized Bengali words, and elongated spellings that characterize real expressions of distress. We introduce BanglishDepYT, a Bengali depression dataset collected natively from YouTube, comprising 191,000 unlabeled comments and 1,000 samples verified through dual bilingual annotation. We propose EPH (Emotion-Preserving Hybrid preprocessing), which converts emoticons to semantic tags, preserves Banglish tokens, protects negation words, and normalizes emotional elongation. A key finding is that preprocessing choice substantially affects performance on informal text: standard cleaning reduces the Banglish Survival Rate to zero (SVM F1: 0.7062), while EPH preserves signals (CESS: 0.9996 vs. 0.6694) and raises SVM F1 to 0.8570, an improv

translated_title: BanglishDepYT：基于情感保留预处理与领域自适应预训练的孟加拉语原生社交媒体抑郁症检测
translated_abstract: 抑郁症影响着南亚数百万孟加拉语使用者，然而自动化检测系统几乎完全依赖于从英语翻译而来的数据集。这类数据集无法捕捉真实痛苦表达中所特有的表情符号、罗马化孟加拉语单词以及拉长的拼写。我们提出了BanglishDepYT，一个从YouTube原生收集的孟加拉语抑郁症数据集，包含191,000条未标注评论和1,000条通过双语双重标注验证的样本。我们提出了EPH（情感保留混合预处理）方法，该方法将表情符号转换为语义标签、保留Banglish词汇、保护否定词并规范化情感性拉长拼写。一个关键发现是，预处理方式对非正式文本的性能有实质性影响：标准清洗方法会将Banglish存活率降为零（SVM F1：0.7062），而EPH保留了情感信号（CESS：0.9996 对比 0.6694），并将SVM F1提升至0.8570，带来了显著的性能改进。
tldr: 该论文发布了首个从YouTube原生收集的孟加拉语抑郁症检测数据集BanglishDepYT，并提出情感保留混合预处理方法EPH，证明预处理方式对非正式社交媒体文本的检测性能影响显著，EPH相比标准清洗方法将SVM F1从0.7062提升至0.8570。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BanglishDepYT, the first natively collected Bengali depression detection dataset from YouTube, and proposes an Emotion-Preserving Hybrid (EPH) preprocessing method, demonstrating that preprocessing choices substantially affect performance on informal social media text by raising SVM F1 from 0.7062 to 0.8570 compared to standard cleaning.
